name: Beat Slice
summary:
Stand on a neon stage and cut the music apart.

BEAT SLICE puts a glowing saber in your hand and sends a steady stream of 3D musical notes past you on both sides - crotchets, quavers, beamed pairs, open half notes - along with the gear that makes the sound: speakers, subwoofers, kick drums, snares, cymbals, a boombox, a vinyl record, a cassette, a mic and an amp.
